intent: Rendere ICTC comprensibile, verificabile e gradevole senza trasformare una baseline ingegneristica in una dichiarazione di conformita o certificazione.

personas.label: Nuovo utente
personas.goal: Capire in meno di un minuto cosa e ICTC, cosa puo fare e da dove iniziare.

personas.label: Operatore
personas.goal: Registrare fatti e materiali con etichette chiare, effetti prevedibili e recupero esplicito.

personas.label: Amministratore
personas.goal: Leggere insieme postura runtime, gap deployment, governance AI e responsabilita.

personas.label: Auditor
personas.goal: Ricostruire architettura, autorita, evidenze, standard e limiti senza scrivere dati.

personas.label: Tecnico
personas.goal: Comprendere stack, confini, persistenza, API, prove e controlli esterni.

benchmarkFamilies.name: WCAG 2.2
benchmarkFamilies.principle: Operable and understandable interaction with visible focus, adequate targets, consistent help and reflow.
benchmarkFamilies.ictcPractice: Semantic HTML, skip link, explicit focus, 44 px targets, text status, reduced motion and responsive linearization.
benchmarkFamilies.limit: Automated and browser checks do not establish WCAG conformance; human and assistive-technology testing remains required.

benchmarkFamilies.name: WAI-ARIA APG
benchmarkFamilies.principle: Prefer native semantics and predictable keyboard behavior for disclosure, dialog and navigation patterns.
benchmarkFamilies.ictcPractice: Native details and dialog elements, labelled regions and explicit current navigation avoid unnecessary custom roles.
benchmarkFamilies.limit: Cross-browser and assistive-technology behavior still requires deployment-context validation.

benchmarkFamilies.name: EN 301 549
benchmarkFamilies.principle: Accessible ICT requirements span web, software and supporting documentation.
benchmarkFamilies.ictcPractice: The repository maps web interaction and documentation controls to an accessibility-oriented baseline.
benchmarkFamilies.limit: No EN 301 549 conformity claim is made; a scoped audit against the applicable version is external evidence.

benchmarkFamilies.name: Directive (EU) 2019/882
benchmarkFamilies.principle: Covered products and services should prevent accessibility barriers in the internal market.
benchmarkFamilies.ictcPractice: Accessibility is treated as a release and deployment concern rather than a cosmetic enhancement.
benchmarkFamilies.limit: Applicability and legal compliance depend on service, market and deployment and are not determined by ICTC.

benchmarkFamilies.name: ISO 9241-210:2019
benchmarkFamilies.principle: Human-centred design is iterative and grounded in users, tasks and operating context throughout the lifecycle.
benchmarkFamilies.ictcPractice: Persona-specific first experience, role journeys, workload states, scenario saturation and iterative falsification.
benchmarkFamilies.limit: Engineered scenarios do not replace research with representative users.

benchmarkFamilies.name: ISO 37301:2021
benchmarkFamilies.principle: Compliance management depends on governance, proportionality, transparency and continual improvement.
benchmarkFamilies.ictcPractice: Explicit authority, reasoned decisions, evidence trails, honest blockers and reviewable governance settings.
benchmarkFamilies.limit: ICTC supports a compliance process; it does not certify an organisation's compliance management system.

benchmarkFamilies.name: NIST CSF 2.0
benchmarkFamilies.principle: Outcome-oriented governance communicates and manages cybersecurity risk without prescribing one implementation.
benchmarkFamilies.ictcPractice: Governance, identity, monitoring, incident response, evidence integrity, recovery and deployment blockers are separated.
benchmarkFamilies.limit: The mapping is informative and is not a NIST CSF organisational profile or assessment.

benchmarkFamilies.name: NIST SSDF 1.1
benchmarkFamilies.principle: Secure development practices and release evidence should be integrated into the software lifecycle.
benchmarkFamilies.ictcPractice: Syntax, contract, runtime, browser, security and saturation gates produce commit-bound artifacts and claims.
benchmarkFamilies.limit: The repository does not prove every organisational SSDF practice or supplier process.

benchmarkFamilies.name: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
benchmarkFamilies.principle: AI interaction and limitations should be transparent while effective human oversight and traceability are preserved.
benchmarkFamilies.ictcPractice: AI output remains a proposal or analysis, human adoption is explicit, traces are separate and limitations are visible.
benchmarkFamilies.limit: ICTC does not determine AI Act classification, provider or deployer obligations, or legal compliance.

benchmarkFamilies.name: GOV.UK Design System and USWDS
benchmarkFamilies.principle: Make the right action clear, reuse predictable components and reveal secondary detail only when needed.
benchmarkFamilies.ictcPractice: One primary action, concise labels, native details, stable navigation and a shared final token resolver.
benchmarkFamilies.limit: ICTC does not implement or claim conformance with either government design system.

benchmarkFamilies.name: NASA HIDH and FAA HFDS
benchmarkFamilies.principle: Safety-critical interfaces need meaningful labels, controlled salience, workload management and predictable controls.
benchmarkFamilies.ictcPractice: Labels state function and effect, critical state uses text, density is bounded and decorative motion is optional.
benchmarkFamilies.limit: ICTC is not aerospace software and makes no aerospace qualification claim.

benchmarkFamilies.name: Site Reliability Engineering practices
benchmarkFamilies.principle: Expose actionable state, distinguish symptoms from causes and design recoverable operations.
benchmarkFamilies.ictcPractice: Readiness, attention items, preserved originals, retry paths and explicit observability blockers support recovery.
benchmarkFamilies.limit: Repository checks are not production service-level objectives or operational telemetry.

architecture.label: Esperienza
architecture.description: HTML semantico, CSS tokenizzato e JavaScript modulare proiettano viste coerenti con ruolo e capacita.

architecture.label: Autorita
architecture.description: Il server autorizza attore e permessi; il client mostra il profilo emesso senza inventare poteri.

architecture.label: API
architecture.description: Il server Node.js espone bootstrap, monitoraggio, materiali, eventi, evidenze, Admin e prova standard.

architecture.label: Runtime di dominio
architecture.description: Monitoraggio, contributi, incidenti e Admin condividono stato canonico e ricevute comuni.

architecture.label: AI governata
architecture.description: Un adapter configurabile propone piani, estrazioni e bozze entro budget, allowlist e confini di rete.

architecture.label: Persistenza canonica
architecture.description: Lo store usa revisione ottimistica, idempotenza, scrittura atomica e allegati separati.

architecture.label: Evidenze
architecture.description: Ogni scrittura produce receipt, digest e un evento nella catena SHA-256 verificabile.

architecture.label: Deployment
architecture.description: IdP, TLS, storage, restore, malware scan, osservabilita e audit AT restano attestazioni esterne.

journeys.label: Monitoraggio
journeys.humanGate: Revisione e attivazione del piano; decisione motivata sulle fonti
journeys.output: Fonte verificata o esclusa con storia ed evidenza

journeys.label: Fascicoli evento
journeys.input: Racconto originale, tempo di conoscenza e allegati
journeys.output: Fascicolo versionato con originale, analisi, decisioni e receipt

journeys.label: Amministrazione
journeys.input: Identita, ambiente, provider, budget e allowlist
journeys.output: Postura con controlli runtime e gap deployment separati

journeys.label: Audit
journeys.input: Fonte, fascicolo o stato da ricostruire
journeys.humanGate: Nessuna scrittura: verifica in sola lettura
journeys.output: Provenienza, versioni, attori, limiti ed export auditor

glossary.definition: Contenuto originale aggiunto prima di una decisione sulla sua qualita o applicabilita.
Elemento del catalogo osservato, candidato, verificato, escluso o superato.
Traccia conservata per ricostruire un'operazione; non equivale a verita sostanziale.
Insieme collegato di originale, allegati, analisi, risposte, versioni, decisioni e ricevute.
Ricevuta di scrittura con attore, revisione, timestamp, digest e catena audit.
Registrazione separata di scopo, input, output, modello, uso e limiti della chiamata AI.
Adozione, correzione, approvazione, esclusione, invio o chiusura attribuita a persona autorizzata.
Identita attiva usata dal server per autorizzare e attribuire operazioni.
Permesso server-side che abilita una specifica lettura o scrittura.
Stato derivato da controlli e attestazioni; un dato mancante resta bloccante.
Condizione verificabile con stato, evidenza, ambito e prossimo passo.
Prova del deployment o dell'organizzazione per un controllo non dimostrabile dal repository.
Mappa tra promessa, pratica, evidenza e limite; non e una certificazione.
Confine oltre il quale ICTC non formula conclusioni tecniche, legali o sostanziali.

definitionOfDone: Release 1.6.0 is propagated across runtime, package, claims and docs.
A fourth support area explains ICTC without becoming a third operational service.
Every role receives a concise role introduction and the same canonical technical facts.
Architecture, journeys, standards, glossary, proof state and limits share one view.
Every standards mapping contains principle, ICTC practice, evidence and limitation.
The UI never labels alignment as certification or legal compliance.
Admin gains one compact proof panel without another write workflow.
Visual aliases resolve to canonical tokens and focus uses a visible outline.
New and enriched controls meet the 44 px baseline.
The proof view reflows without horizontal document overflow.
Loading, failure and retry are explicit.
The proof endpoint is read-only for all roles and contains no secrets.
N+100 introduces zero canonical semantic primitive.
Static, runtime, browser, security and legacy gates pass on one commit.
claimBoundary: Repository and selected runtime/browser assurance only. No legal opinion, standards certification, production deployment certification or complete human accessibility audit is implied.
